ops.text: IV Licensee is the "Customer" for purposes of this clause IV. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund to Customer any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article IV locks us into a 36-month term with no exit right, so we have added clause IV giving us termination for convenience on 30 days' prior written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, consistent with our preferred termination position. Licensor's only termination right remains the existing breach-based right.
proposal.summary: Insert Licensee/Customer convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
mappings.quote: Upon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder, the Licensor may immediately terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology.
